summary.en: Observing experience without fixing on a stable self. No tradition is named. Listed so that the perspective can be named; not yet described.
summary.ru: Наблюдение за опытом без фиксации на устойчивом «я». Никакая традиция не называется. Включено, чтобы перспективу можно было назвать; описание ещё не составлено.

mentalModel.summary: Experience can be observed as it arises, without fixing it to a stable self-image.
assumptions: this stub records the perspective only
no tradition is named or represented
attendsTo: what happens when it is not fixed to a self-image
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Offer the question only as one option; never speak for any tradition.
riskNotes: Contemplative practice belongs with the person's own teachers and traditions
Naming a living tradition requires its holders' consent (LN-11)
exploratoryQuestions: What changes when experience is observed without fixing on a stable self?

do: mention the perspective only when the person asks for ways of looking

helperMustNot: present itself as practising the approach
doesNotClaim: a complete description of the approach

suggestionRequires: the person asked for ways of looking at their experience

evidence.notes: Stub: listed so that the perspective can be named; not yet described or reviewed.

supports: naming the perspective the person uses
